_comment: Pre-registered per-fault QC panel for Train Ticket (the TT analogue of faults/verification_targets.json). For each fault, the Prometheus signal(s) that MUST move if the injection took effect; verify_injection.py scores baseline vs injection windows -> confirmed|borderline|unconfirmed. One canonical=true per fault drives the verdict. These are QC gates, NOT the study's modality claims.
_metric_naming: TT services expose NO app-level request-duration metrics (no micrometer/actuator - see prometheus-tt.yml), so every signal here is cAdvisor (per-container CPU/mem/net) or node-exporter (host). cAdvisor 'name' label = the container name: services = 'trainticket_ts-<svc>-service_1' (match '.*ts-<svc>-service_1$'); the shared DB = 'mysql' (exact); noisy neighbor = '.*noisy-neighbor.*'. Consequence: latency-type faults (slow_db, svc_net, anomaly_net) have NO direct app-metric signal on TT - they verify via a closed-loop THROUGHPUT drop and are metrics-WEAK by design (the study's point: kernel/traces + the client-side load CSV carry them). Thresholds marked CALIBRATE are provisional pending VM calibration.

_windows._note: INJECTION_S >= 120 so a settled segment remains after the 1m-rate ramp.

slow_db_mysql.name: mysql_cpu_throughput_drop
slow_db_mysql.why: CALIBRATE. Latency toxic on the shared mysql proxy: in the closed loop fewer queries/s complete -> mysql does less work/s -> CPU drops. METRICS-WEAK & a trace BLIND SPOT (mysql uninstrumented); the real signal is the KERNEL (services blocked in read() on the DB socket) + the client-side latency in the load CSV. Mirrors slow_db_catalogue on Sock Shop but starker (no app latency metric at all).

error_storm_mysql.name: mysql_net_recv_drop
error_storm_mysql.why: CALIBRATE. timeout/reset_peer toxic breaks DB connections -> fewer successful queries reach mysql -> inbound bytes drop. The primary error signal (5xx to clients) lives in the LOAD CSV + service LOGS, not Prometheus (no app metrics).

svc_cpu_cap_ts-travel-service.name: travel_cpu_usage_capped
svc_cpu_cap_ts-travel-service.why: CALIBRATE. cgroup quota pins ts-travel-service CPU at/below the cap (0.5 subtle / 0.2 aggressive). Reliable cAdvisor signal (same mechanism as Sock Shop svc_cpu_cap_carts). App-latency inflation is trace/kernel-visible but has no TT Prometheus metric.

svc_mem_cap_ts-order-service.name: order_memory_limit_dropped
svc_mem_cap_ts-order-service.why: The cap is applied: the limit drops from host-total to the cap (<= a few hundred MB). Reliable for both intensities (same as Sock Shop svc_mem_cap_carts).

svc_mem_cap_ts-order-service.name: order_oom_kills
svc_mem_cap_ts-order-service.why: an aggressive cap below the JVM working set forces OOM kills; subtle causes GC pressure without necessarily OOMing. CALIBRATE the cap vs the Spring Boot heap.

svc_net_ts-basic-service.name: basic_net_throughput_drop
svc_net_ts-basic-service.why: CALIBRATE. per-netns netem inside ts-basic-service inflates its hop latency -> in the closed loop it completes fewer aggregations/s -> transmit bytes drop. METRICS-WEAK (no app latency); traces/kernel carry the latency.

dependency_outage_ts-seat-service.name: seat_cpu_drops_to_zero
dependency_outage_ts-seat-service.why: docker pause FREEZES ts-seat-service -> its CPU goes to ~0. Reliable. But the CALLER-side impact (travel/preserve threads blocked on the frozen seat socket) is metrics/logs-INVISIBLE - a frozen dependency is exactly the kernel-wins case (blocked read() on the seat socket), same finding as Sock Shop dependency_outage.

noisy_neighbor.name: neighbor_cpu_active
noisy_neighbor.why: verifies the neighbor stressor FIRED (app-agnostic container). The premise - TT booking KPIs stay within normal variance under mild host CPU contention - is the study finding, not a QC gate. CALIBRATE the cap so KPIs barely move.

anomaly_cpu.name: host_cpu_nonidle
anomaly_cpu.why: host-wide stress-ng saturates all cores (node-exporter, app-agnostic - identical to Sock Shop).

anomaly_mem.name: host_mem_available_drop
anomaly_mem.why: stress-ng --vm drives MemAvailable down (node-exporter, app-agnostic). CALIBRATE the bound so it does not OOM-kill lttng/JVMs on the 64GB box.

anomaly_disk.name: host_disk_io_time
anomaly_disk.why: stress-ng --hdd saturates block I/O (node-exporter, app-agnostic - identical to Sock Shop).

anomaly_net.name: mysql_net_recv_drop_hostnet
anomaly_net.why: CALIBRATE. host-bridge netem (delay + loss) inflates every inter-container hop -> the closed loop slows -> fewer queries reach the shared mysql -> inbound bytes drop. No app-latency metric on TT (Sock Shop used catalogue p95); a container-throughput proxy is the closest Prometheus signal, traces carry the real latency.
